latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of assembly-large-audio-transcriber skill.
- Transcribes large audio files (100MB–1GB, up to 12 hours) with speaker diarization using AssemblyAI API via HTTP calls.
- Supports MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG, and WEBM formats with no SDK dependencies (only requires `requests`).
- Provides word-level timestamps, multi-language support (auto-detection), and detailed output including speaker and time segmentation.
- Includes robust error handling and guidance for API limits and file splitting.
- Output can be archived to a specified directory with structured Markdown or JSON formatting.
